description: Attestation-based client authentication at the token endpoint: a client's attestation_* extended properties refused by the policy the token-endpoint filter and the OGNL criterion share (plan item S4c). The verified and refused decisions themselves are attestation.client.verified and attestation.client.refused, in the federation catalogue.

endpoint.description: Where the client's properties were read: token_endpoint_filter, issuance_criterion or startup_scan.

property.description: The name of the attestation_* extended property refused. Its value is never recorded.

attestation.policy.invalid.description: A client's attestation_* extended property does not parse, holds more than one value, or would loosen the server's policy (the reason: unparsable, loosens, empty_intersection or foreign_htu), so the client is refused with 401 invalid_client. The start-up scan records each client once, when it is first found.
